sentence: This project offers bioinformatics and big data analysis to support research on host-pathogen interactions and systems biology.
This project studies how natural variants of cancer-linked viral proteins escape the immune system in mice, aiming to build a therapeutic vaccine.
This project tests a phone-based intervention that helps young adults who use alcohol keep up brain training from the scanner in daily life.
This project builds a nanocarrier that delivers RNA for cancer treatment while avoiding cationic charges.
This project studies how a human enterovirus infects ocular cells, using corneal organoids that model the human ocular surface.
This project tries to find out how a gene mutation and therapeutic resistance control lung tumor growth.
This project studies how dental pulp stem cells change and tries to use them to regrow tubular dentin.
This project tests digital treatments that target how people feel during activity, to help adults at elevated cancer risk keep up physical activity.
This project builds algorithms that predict and detect worsening of advanced glaucoma using visual field and optical imaging data.
This project studies language use and psychophysiology together to understand emotional arousal and regulation in Veterans at different risk of suicide.
This project activates a brain circuit that controls brain arousal to find out whether it prevents seizures in animal models.
This project tests whether a mobile peer recovery support app improves outcomes for people with opioid use disorder who were in jail or prison.
This project builds single-cell technology to measure DNA methylation, chromatin and splicing together and find how they relate in health and disease.
This project uses genetic data, clinical data and cardiac tissues to find which genetic factors cause congenital heart disease and shape outcomes.
This project studies how a developmental signaling pathway that controls cell and tissue morphogenesis works and how it goes wrong in human diseases.
This project tests whether ketones act directly on sensory neurons to help axon growth, sensation and pain in diabetic peripheral neuropathy.
This project tries to find out how pluripotent stem cells from different species compete and how to stop that competition.
This project studies how people and deep neural network models recognize object images that are degraded by visual noise or blur.
This project studies how mutated hematopoietic stem cells outgrow normal cells in zebrafish and how macrophages and choline metabolism affect that.
This project develops a technology to monitor for the start of type 1 diabetes before insulin-producing cells are destroyed.
